item.title: Modular JavaScript with ES Modules
item.description: Remember when a complex JavaScript project was just one massive 4,000-line script.js file, or ten <script> tags dumped in your HTML hoping the global variables wouldn’t clash? :') Those days are thankfully behind us. With ES Modules (ESM), native modularity is supported directly by both modern browsers and runtime engines. You can split your logic into dedicated files, export only what’s necessary, and keep global scope spotless. 1. Exporting Code: Named vs Default There are two primary ways to share code from a file:
